Are you ready to turn machine data into real-time insights that strengthen manufacturing operations worldwide? We’re looking for a hands-on Senior System Engineer with deep expertise in industrial connectivity, automation and IoT to create seamless connections between production equipment and our digital platform. 
 
Here, you get the opportunity to:  
Work with advanced digital solutions and data generated directly from the shop floor. 
Gain broad exposure to global manufacturing technologies and information flows.  
Join a product environment offering varied challenges and opportunities to grow. 

 
About your job 
In this global position, you ensure reliable connectivity between industrial machines at our production units and the digital platform. By collecting, transferring and integrating machine data, you enable real-time analysis, informed decision-making and improved machine performance. 
 
Job responsibilities 

Establish and maintain reliable data connections between industrial machines and the digital platform. 
Implement and troubleshoot connectivity solutions for PLCs, sensors, SCADA systems and other industrial equipment.  
Develop, test and deploy protocols, interfaces and APIs that connect machines with backend systems.  
Integrate machine-generated data with digital platforms and cloud services in collaboration with data engineers and IT teams. 
Diagnose connectivity issues across Ethernet, Modbus and industrial networks, both remotely and on-site.  
Drive connectivity best practices and identify improvements that strengthen data integrity, machine uptime and infrastructure performance. 

 
Location 
This is an on-site position based in Sandviken or Gimo in Sweden or Pune in India. As close collaboration with production is essential, you need to be located near one of these manufacturing sites.  
 
Your profile 
You’re an experienced engineer with a strong background in machine connectivity, industrial automation or IoT. Combining broad technical knowledge with a hands-on approach, you independently drive connectivity activities across a global manufacturing environment. 
 
Your background includes 
A bachelor’s degree om electronics and communication engineering, instrumentation, computer science or a related field.  
Extensive experience in machine connectivity, industrial automation or IoT. 
Hands-on knowledge of Modbus, OPC UA, MQTT, RESTful APIs and protocol converters or gateways. 
Experience with industrial systems such as PLCs, SCADA, DCS and sensors, as well as computer networks and TCP/IP. 
Experience with cloud platforms and data integration tools, such as Azure. 
Strong communication skills in English.  

 
A master’s degree is beneficial. Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, cybersecurity, Jenkins, Jira or databases such as SQL Server, Redis, NoSQL or DB2 is also considered an advantage.  
 
Taking ownership comes naturally to you, and you’re comfortable guiding others within your area of expertise. With patience and curiosity, you ask the right questions, understand stakeholder requirements and work through complex technical issues. Clear communication helps you collaborate across functions, segments and production units while keeping data flowing accurately and reliably. 
 
Our culture 
Innovation is in our DNA and we’re proud to shape the future of manufacturing in close collaboration with our customers and partners. We believe in an inclusive, equal and open-minded culture, and we nurture our diversities to form a solid foundation for achieving great results. Add fair and rewarding benefits, as well as many different career opportunities in an inspiring global environment. Meet some of your future colleagues at our career page or visit our website, LinkedIn or Facebook page to get to know us further.

jobs.occupation: Secondary Swedish MYP Language  A and B Teacher
jobs.description:
Reports to: Middle School Principal

Job Description
Teacher for Swedish Language and Literature for Middle Years Programme, grades 6 - 9. This is a Permanent part-time position (60%).  
Our vision
To be recognised as a leading international school that inspires and educates generations of global change-makers. 	
Our mission
Stockholm International School inspires and educates children of the global community through internationally recognised learning programs. We enable international mobility and support growth and talent development in the Stockholm region and beyond. 

Duties/Responsibilities:
A teacher is responsible for the preparation, instruction and follow-up involved in teaching the designated curricula. 
A teacher also has the following duties and areas of responsibility:
● The academic, personal and social welfare of students
● Assessing learning and grading all students in relation to the curricula
● Collaborate with Language B and Language A Teachers on placement tests and transition policies.
● Informing parents with regard to academic and social questions
● Actively participating in Parent/ Teacher/Student conferences
● Comfortable with the use of technology in the classroom, for example the use of ManageBac, Google Classroom, Seesaw, etc
● Ensuring that student attendance is checked and recorded in accordance with the security regulations of the school
● Attending and taking part in planned meetings set by the school and or leadership.
● Attending other meetings called with 2 weeks’ notice
● Being an advisor/mentor for projects e.g. Personal Project (MYP) 
● Learning and Incorporating Positive Discipline practices both in and out of the classroom
● Serving as Homeroom teacher, or Advisory teacher* when appointed/elected. 
● Acting as leaders for Sport/outdoor events during directed working time 
● Being available for school trips or learning outside of school. 
● Actively contributing to teams, committees and task forces.
● Contributing to the development, documentation and implementation of curriculum.
● Participating in Professional Development
● Upholding the Child Protection measures implemented at school

Qualifications and Experience: 
● Be familiar with IBMYP curricula or and equivalent international curricula
● Fluent in written and spoken English and Swedish
● Have excellent communication skills
● Be able to establish rapport with adults and students
● Be able to work effectively in a team
● Be able to function effectively under pressure
● Perform their duties conscientiously
● Be able to show initiative and work independently
● Have a pleasant and friendly personality
● Preferred qualification to teach other disciplines

At Stockholm International School we are committed to protecting children. Aligned with the recommendations of the International Task Force on Child Protection, we hold ourselves to a high standard of effective recruiting practices with specific attention to child protection. All applicants will therefore be required to undergo appropriate child protection screening. Included in the recruitment process will be a local and national police check as well as a mandatory police background check from the last 10 years of employment in every country worked. A judicial background check will be conducted prior to the issuance of the contract for prospective candidates applying to work at our school.

What we offer:
As well as the exciting opportunities this role presents, we also offer benefits in terms of; a pension scheme (Alecta ITP 1/ITP2), a generous wellness stipend, other insurances, and a substantial amount of professional development opportunities inside and outside the school. We also offer staff events and social gatherings that bring colleagues together, for example, hobby evenings and choir practices. Our location in central Stockholm is easily accessible by public transportation. 
Contract: Part-time (60%) (Posibility of more time if the candidate is willing teach Swedish in the Primary 20%) 
Permanent Contract (with a 6-months probationary period) 
Salary: Fixed salary (salary scale)
Starting: January 7, 2027

Application: 
Last day for applications December 6, 2026 (the interview process can start earlier). Please note that, in order to work at SIS, you must hold a valid work permit or be an EU citizen. SIS reserves the right to close the application process at any time once a suitable candidate is found and accepts the position. We only accept applications in English and from qualified teachers. Please send a letter of interest, your CV and two references to application@intsch.se. Mark the email with “Secondary Swedish MYP Teacher”.

Company: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB
Role: Senior Product Development Project Manager / Supplier Risk Leader
Specialisation: Automotive Product Development | Supplier Risk Management | Crisis Management | Project Leadership | Stakeholder Management
Seniority: Senior
Location: Gothenburg, Sweden
Language: Fluent English (spoken and written)
Type: IT Consulting Assignment
About the Role
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced Senior Product Development Project Manager to take responsibility for supplier risk management and crisis coordination within a complex automotive product development environment.
In this role, you will work closely with product owners, project leaders and senior engineering stakeholders to identify potential supplier-related risks at an early stage, coordinate appropriate actions and ensure minimal disruption to product development activities.
You will play a key role in managing critical situations, driving cross-functional collaboration and improving processes related to supplier risk identification, escalation and crisis management.
Key Responsibilities
1. Supplier Risk & Crisis Management
Identify, assess and proactively manage supplier-related risks affecting product development activities.
Monitor early risk indicators and initiate appropriate actions to prevent potential disruptions.
Coordinate crisis management activities and ensure timely responses to critical situations.
Prepare risk-related cases and support decisions on appropriate actions and next steps.
Ensure relevant resources are engaged and stakeholders are informed.
Guide engineering and product development teams through challenging supplier-related situations.

2. Project & Stakeholder Coordination
Collaborate closely with project leaders, crisis management teams and product owners.
Maintain regular communication with product owners to anticipate potential issues and identify effective solutions.
Coordinate risk-related activities across different product development organizations.
Facilitate discussions and ensure alignment between engineering teams and senior stakeholders.
Support effective decision-making and ensure clear ownership of actions.
Communicate risks, priorities and recommended actions to relevant stakeholders.

3. Risk Assessment & Decision Support
Analyse supplier-related challenges and evaluate their potential impact on product development.
Prepare decision-making material and recommend appropriate courses of action.
Ensure the right technical and organizational resources are involved in resolving issues.
Support prioritization of activities based on business impact, urgency and operational requirements.
Drive issues towards resolution through structured follow-up and coordination.

4. Process Improvement & Leadership
Develop and improve working methods for supplier risk and crisis management.
Identify opportunities to improve risk identification, escalation and communication processes.
Promote proactive risk management practices across engineering and project teams.
Share knowledge and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
Support efficient collaboration between product owners, project management and engineering organizations.

Required Skills & Experience
Degree in Engineering or an equivalent technical qualification.
Professional experience in automotive product development.
Previous experience in project management or a strong understanding of project management processes.
Good understanding of supplier-related risks and their impact on product development.
Strong stakeholder management and networking capabilities.
Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and complex engineering activities.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Experience interacting with senior management and decision-makers.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and respond effectively to challenging situations.
Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

What We’re Looking For
We are looking for a dynamic, flexible and decisive professional who can proactively identify risks, bring stakeholders together and drive effective solutions.
The ideal candidate should have strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to navigate complex organizational structures and build effective professional networks.
You should be comfortable handling challenging situations, facilitating discussions with senior stakeholders and ensuring that critical issues receive timely attention.
A proactive mindset, sound judgement and the ability to turn potential risks into structured actions are essential for success in this role.

Privileged access is central to protecting critical systems and information. As Product Owner for Privileged Access Management (PAM), you combine strong product ownership with an understanding of identity and access management to help identify, control, and secure privileged access across Sandvik’s digital environment. 
The team 
You join Identity Fabric, a Product Area within Sandvik Cybersecurity and the central area for digital identities and Identity & Access Management. Identity Fabric brings together several teams working across cybersecurity, IAM, IT platforms, governance, and user experience.  
The focus is on creating effective and secure ways to manage privileged identities and access across Sandvik. Within this landscape, PAM addresses access with elevated privileges and helps strengthen how privileged accounts and other identities are identified, managed, and secured.  
About the job 
You take ownership of Sandvik’s PAM capability, with responsibility for outcomes, roadmap, and budget. A key part of your assignment is developing the capability from implementation into an operational service and creating clear priorities for continued improvement.   
Job responsibilities 
Own and prioritize the backlog, translating business and security needs into clear deliverables. 
Define the roadmap, service maturity, KPIs and improvement priorities. 
Coordinate the onboarding of applications and platforms into PAM. 
Drive decisions and collaboration across cybersecurity, IAM, infrastructure, application teams, vendors, service management and the business. 
Support an effective approach to identifying and securing privileged access, focusing on reducing risk rather than on individual tools. 

Location 
This position is based on-site at the World Trade Center in Stockholm.  
Your profile 
You bring strong product ownership experience from an enterprise IT or security service, combined with a solid understanding of PAM. You know why PAM matters and have enough technical knowledge to turn business and security needs into clear priorities and deliverables. 
Your background includes 
Experience as a Product Owner, Service Owner, Product Manager or in a similar coordinating position, with responsibility for areas such as backlog, prioritization, roadmap and service development. 
Good knowledge of IAM and PAM concepts, including privileged and service accounts, credential management, least privilege, access lifecycle, session management and time-bound privileged access. 
A basic understanding of Entra ID and hybrid or on-premises environments. 
Experience working with external delivery partners or managed-service providers, as well as change management. 
Professional English. 

You’re driven and outgoing, with a collaborative way of working and strong stakeholder management skills. Comfortable working across organizational boundaries, you bring people together, influence decisions, and keep progress moving even when ownership is shared across several teams. 
Our culture 
Our role is clear – through every action, every day, we make the shift and advance the world through engineering. Vi söker dig som har gedigen praktisk erfarenhet av FUE och vill bidra till att utveckla ett välfungerande hårtransplantationsteam.

Förberedelser och assisterande arbete vid FUE-hårtransplantationer, inklusive motoriserade och manuella metoder.
Hantering, sortering, preparering och kvalitetskontroll av hårgrafts.
Mikroskopisk dissektion och bedömning av grafts.

Förberedelse av operationsrum, instrument och utrustning.
Säkerställa god hygien, aseptik och strukturerade arbetsrutiner.

Medverka i utveckling av arbetsflöden och kvalitetsrutiner.

Dokumenterad praktisk erfarenhet av hårtransplantation.
God kunskap om FUE, inklusive motoriserade och/eller manuella tekniker.
Erfarenhet av graft-hantering, sortering och preparering.
God förståelse för hygien, aseptik och patientsäkerhet.
God kommunikationsförmåga på engelska.
Noggrannhet, ansvarskänsla, god samarbetsförmåga och professionellt patientbemötande.

Erfarenhet av FUT och mikroskopisk dissektion.
Erfarenhet av ögonbryns- och skäggtransplantation.
Erfarenhet av att handleda och utbilda andra hårtransplantationstekniker.
Språkkunskaper i svenska, persiska (farsi) eller turkiska.

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Legitimerad speciallärare med inriktning mot matematikutveckling till IES Sigtuna 

Vill du arbeta på en skola där specialpedagogisk kompetens spelar en central roll för att varje elev ska lyckas? 

Internationella Engelska Skolan Sigtuna söker en engagerad och legitimerad speciallärare med kompetens inom matematikutveckling. Vi söker dig som vill säkerställa att våra elever får rätt stöd, vid rätt tidpunkt och utifrån sina individuella behov, med särskilt fokus på elever som behöver stöd i matematik. 

Du har höga förväntningar på alla elevers förmåga att utvecklas och lyckas. Du är trygg i din profession, väl insatt i specialpedagogiska arbetssätt och van vid att omsätta dina kunskaper i praktiken. Du ser till elevens hela skolsituation och förstår att framgångsrika insatser bygger på nära samarbete mellan elev, vårdnadshavare, lärare, elevhälsa och skolledning. 

IES Sigtuna är en mångkulturell och tvåspråkig skola. Du behöver därför kunna kommunicera obehindrat på svenska och väl på engelska. 

Om rollen 

Som speciallärare arbetar du både direkt med elever och konsultativt gentemot skolans lärare. Beroende på elevernas behov arbetar du enskilt, i mindre grupper och i klassrummet. 

En viktig del av uppdraget är att kartlägga och stödja elevers matematiska utveckling. Du planerar, genomför och följer upp riktade insatser för elever som behöver särskilt stöd i matematik. Du handleder även lärare i hur matematikundervisningen kan anpassas och göras mer tillgänglig. 

Du blir en viktig del av skolans SEN-team och arbetar nära elevhälsoteamet, vår Student Care Manager, våra Academic Managers och skolledningen. Tillsammans utvecklar ni skolans arbete med extra anpassningar, särskilt stöd, skolnärvaro och tillgängliga lärmiljöer. 

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter 

• Undervisa och stödja elever enskilt, i mindre grupper och i klassrummet. • Kartlägga elevers matematiska utveckling och identifiera hinder för lärande. • Planera, genomföra och utvärdera riktade stödinsatser i matematik. • Handleda lärare i anpassad och tillgänglig matematikundervisning. • Genomföra pedagogiska kartläggningar och utredningar. • Utarbeta, följa upp och utvärdera åtgärdsprogram. • Dokumentera insatser och elevärenden i ProRenata. • Arbeta med elever som har problematisk skolfrånvaro. • Observera lektioner och handleda lärare kring extra anpassningar, särskilt stöd och tillgängliga lärmiljöer. • Delta i möten med elever, vårdnadshavare, kollegor och externa aktörer. • Samverka med elevhälsan och skolledningen kring stödinsatser. • Bidra till utvecklingen av skolans elevhälsoarbete. 

Vi söker dig som 

• har svensk lärarlegitimation och speciallärarexamen med inriktning mot matematikutveckling, • har kunskap om matematiksvårigheter och metoder för att stödja elevers matematiska utveckling, • har erfarenhet av pedagogiska kartläggningar, utredningar och åtgärdsprogram, • har erfarenhet av elever med neuropsykiatriska funktionsnedsättningar och andra behov av särskilt stöd, • har god förståelse för skolans styrdokument och bestämmelser om särskilt stöd, • uttrycker dig obehindrat på svenska och kan kommunicera väl på engelska, • arbetar strukturerat, självständigt och lösningsorienterat, och • har lätt för att skapa goda relationer och samarbeta med andra. 

Erfarenhet av problematisk skolfrånvaro och dokumentation i ProRenata är meriterande. 

Om IES Sigtuna 

Internationella Engelska Skolan Sigtuna är en tvåspråkig F–9-skola med cirka 600 elever. Undervisningen bedrivs på svenska och engelska i en internationell och mångkulturell miljö. 

Hos oss står kunskap, trygghet och höga förväntningar i centrum. Vi arbetar tillsammans för att skapa en lugn och välstrukturerad skolmiljö där eleverna kan fokusera på sitt lärande och utvecklas både akademiskt och socialt. 

Som medarbetare blir du en del av ett engagerat och internationellt kollegium som värdesätter samarbete, tydlighet och professionellt ansvar. 

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan via IES Careers!

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

Business Developer – International Markets

Sigster Pictures AB is a Stockholm-based consulting and creative company working across
business development, strategy, branding, film, design and product development.
We help businesses identify opportunities, develop new concepts and turn ideas into
commercially viable projects. By connecting international clients with Swedish expertise, we
support business growth, creative development and access to new markets.

international business, initially focusing on Asian markets and gradually developing
opportunities in other regions.

consulting and business-development opportunities. Working closely with Sigster Pictures
AB, you will help clients understand how our expertise can support their business objectives
and turn opportunities into concrete projects.

understanding of creative industries, such as fashion, graphic design, film, branding, product
development, retail or related fields. You may have started your career in a creative or

international partners.

development opportunities.

and relevant partners as needed.

About You

understand both the creative and commercial sides of a business and recognise how ideas,
products and services can create value for clients.A university degree or bachelor's-level qualification is required, preferably in business,
design, creative industries, marketing, communications, product development or a related
field.
We are looking for someone with:

commercial role.

International & Asian Markets
The role will initially focus on Asian markets, with opportunities to expand into other
regions. Experience working with markets such as China, India, Southeast Asia or other
international markets is an advantage.
Knowledge of international business environments, supply chains, product development or

What We Offer
At Sigster Pictures AB, you will work in a growing company where international business
development, consulting and creative expertise come together.
The role offers the opportunity to:

 Work directly with international clients and partners.

product development.
 Take responsibility for building new business relationships and developing
opportunities into projects.
 Work in a flexible, entrepreneurial environment based in Stockholm.How to Apply
Please submit your CV and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience,
international business exposure and interest in the role.
Employment: Permanent, full-time
Location: Stockholm, Sweden
Working language: English

Join an AI-driven Tech Company and help build a modern finance function? Are you ready to take the next step in your career? Perhaps you have built a strong foundation at an accounting firm or in an in-house finance team, and are now looking for a more dynamic environment where you can take greater ownership, make a real impact, and help shape how things are done. 
Tendium is looking for an experienced Accountant to join the team.  
The Finance team owns the numbers at Tendium. We are building the finance function of tomorrow, where AI and automation handle repetitive tasks, allowing you to focus on work that requires your expertise and judgment. You will not only work within existing structures but also help shape them by documenting procedures, improving workflows, and building scalable processes as we grow.
About Tendium
Tendium is the global pioneer in AI-driven public tender management, transforming how companies discover, analyse, and win government contracts. Our platform turns complex processes into something simple and transparent, empowering businesses to compete fairly for billions in public sector opportunities. We’ve been building our AI-native platform since 2018, leveraging a vast data moat, agentic AI, and tens of thousands of hours of R&D. Today, we serve large numbers of customers across Europe and are rapidly scaling.
The Role
This is a hands-on role with broad responsibility. You'll work closely with the CFO and take ownership of important parts of our day-to-day accounting while helping us develop scalable processes as we grow. Your responsibilities will include:

Monthly Closing & Reconciliations: Independently perform monthly closings, balance sheet reconciliations, accruals, and VAT reporting across multiple group entities.

Revenue Recognition: Manage revenue reconciliations and deferrals related to customer contracts and subscription invoicing.

Accounts Receivable: Own invoicing, customer payments, reminders, and collections.

Day-to-Day Accounting: Handle bookkeeping, supplier invoices, payments, expenses, payroll support, and intercompany transactions.

Year-End Closing & Audit: Support year-end closings, annual reports, and audits together with the CFO.

Systems & Improvements: Improve and document accounting routines, develop workflows, and explore how automation and AI can make our finance processes more efficient.

Who you are
We value ambition, ownership, and the right mindset as much as experience.

Independent & Proactive: You take ownership of your work, drive tasks to completion autonomously, and proactively identify challenges, find solutions, and seek support when needed.

Attention to Detail: Your reconciliations are accurate, and you investigate discrepancies until you fully understand them and can clearly explain their causes.

Adaptable & Growth Mindset: You thrive in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift, challenges evolve, and not everything is figured out yet. You're eager to learn, open to feedback, and motivated by the opportunity to grow alongside the company.

Curious & Tech-Savvy: You're curious about new technologies and eager to explore how AI and automation can improve financial processes. You have strong systems proficiency, understand API integrations, and continuously look for smarter, more efficient ways of working.

Process Builder: You are comfortable working without established procedures and understand how to create scalable processes by collaborating with other system owners and specialists.

Fluent in English, proficient in Swedish

Your experience
3–6 years of relevant accounting experience, ideally from a Swedish accounting firm (redovisningsbyrå) or a similar role in-house with broad accounting responsibilities.

Solid practical experience with Swedish bookkeeping, VAT, reconciliations, and monthly closings.

Experience independently managing accounting for one or several Swedish companies, from day-to-day transactions through monthly closing.

Comfortable working directly in accounting systems and handling  accounting tasks.

Good communication skills in Swedish and English.

Nice to have:

Experience with Fortnox.

Experience preparing year-end accounts and annual reports.

Experience with SaaS, subscription billing, or revenue deferrals.

Experience improving accounting processes or implementing automation.

Application
Excited to join us? Apply today! We review applications on a rolling basis and look forward to getting to know you. Please note that we are currently unable to offer visa sponsorship or work permit support for this position. Applicants must already have the legal right to work in Sweden.

 Equality and Inclusion
At Tendium, we celebrate diversity and strive to create a workplace where everyone feels included, heard, and valued. We believe different perspectives drive innovation and welcome people from all backgrounds to help shape the future together.

jobs.employer_name: Who Collaborating Centre For Int Drug Monitoring
jobs.description:
Would you like to contribute to safer use of medicines and vaccines globally? We are looking for a Data Scientist for the Research Department at Uppsala Monitoring Centre (UMC). You will join a multicultural and dynamic environment with a clear focus to ensure patient safety globally.
Since 1978, Uppsala Monitoring Centre (UMC) has been dedicated to developing, supporting, and expanding the field of pharmacovigilance science and practice.
As a World Health Organization (WHO) Collaborating Centre, we support work around the world to examine the potential adverse effects of medicines and vaccines and contribute to safer, more informed care of patients.
We are a diverse, international group of pharmacists, physicians, data scientists, system developers, communicators, and many other professionals motivated by a deep belief that the work we do matters.
About the role
Research at UMC is a team effort. Pharmacovigilance experts, engineers, and data scientists work side by side to develop the best ideas and solutions. We are looking for a Data Scientist with excellent technical skills who thrives on collaboration. You will join a self-organising agile team where members share ideas openly, plan their work together, give each other honest feedback, and take joint ownership of outcomes.
You will report to our Head of Data Science, Angnis Schmidt-May.
What you will do 
You will help us make better use of data from different sources, the main one being our global database of adverse event reports. Your work will mostly cover the following areas:
Machine learning, natural language processing & large language models: develop methods to support signal management using data from case reports and scientific literature. You will judge carefully when and how AI can be trusted to enhance our research.
Scientific research and dissemination: design and run studies in internal and external collaborations, publish in peer-reviewed journals and present at international conferences.
Sharing methods and assets: make our methods and tools available to others, for example as open-source packages, documented workflows, and reusable models.
Product research: develop innovative methods and conduct exploratory research to improve UMC's products and services. You will work closely with product teams to turn research ideas into useful product features.

Who you are
You are an excellent collaborator. You listen to others and build on their ideas. You share credit and lift the people around you.
You are curious and eager to grow. You seek feedback, reflect on it and act on it. You see learning and development as a lifelong part of your career.
You care about the purpose. Patient safety matters to you, and you hold yourself to high standards of scientific integrity. 

Must have
PhD in a quantitative field (e.g., statistics, computer science, computational linguistics, epidemiology, physics), or a master's degree and PhD-equivalent research experience
Track record of scientific work, such as peer-reviewed publications or conference presentations
Minimum of 5 years of practical experience in data science (from industry or research)
Strong Python/R skills
Fluent written and spoken English

Nice to have
Knowledge of
best practices in software engineering
pharmacovigilance, medical terminologies (e.g., MedDRA) or experience working with health data

Experience
working on open-source code
working with cloud infrastructure
working with GenAI and agentic workflows
taking models and methods from research into production
working with user research and product development
mentoring or supervising others

Uppsala Monitoring Centre (UMC) is an independent, self-funded, non-profit foundation established in 1978 dedicated to safer use of medicines and vaccines. Through an agreement between the Government of Sweden and the World Health Organization (WHO), UMC operates the Programme for International Drug Monitoring, supporting over 180 member countries and regions in strengthening safety surveillance, and maintains VigiBase, the WHO global database of adverse event reports. In addition, UMC provides international standards and related digital solutions for secure exchange of pharmacovigilance data, including a global medicine and vaccine terminology for identification of medicinal products. With around 200 staff, UMC advances the science of pharmacovigilance and transforms its practice through technological innovation.

UMC’s working language is English. We normally apply a probationary period to new appointments.
If you have any questions regarding this position please contact the responsible manager. You will find the contact details at the end of this page.
UMC follows the collective agreements between the Swedish Agency for Government Employers and Saco-S and ST. Union representatives are Malin Zaar (Saco-S) and Jessica Avasol (ST), +46 (0)18-65 60 60.

jobs.occupation: Business Team Director E-com to Lindex, Gothenburg
jobs.description:

This is a broad business and channel leadership role with influence over the future of Lindex’s digital commerce. You build an empowered Business Team and balance current sales and delivery with continued development of customer experience, omnichannel growth, operating model and digital capabilities.
You play a key part in shaping a more customer- and market-led international retail business and helping accelerate Lindex’s future growth journey.

As Business Team Director E-com, you own the digital sales channel and its P&L, spanning site, app, digital trading and merchandising, customer experience, fulfilment, returns and customer service. You connect commercial performance with digital product, technology, data and AI-enabled development to strengthen both today’s business and the next generation of commerce capabilities.
You lead an empowered Business Team together with a Digital Co-Lead, combining business ownership, digital development and continuous improvement. The team is accountable for running, optimising and developing its area, balancing short-term performance with long-term growth and capability development.
The Business Team is supported by Business & Process Developers, analytics capabilities and other functional expertise. The role reports to the Chief Commercial Officer and is part of the Commercial Management team.

You are a commercially grounded e-commerce leader who understands how trading, customer experience, operations, technology and data combine to create profitable growth. Strong understanding of digital business models, acquisition, loyalty, conversion optimisation and customer lifetime value.
Experience integrating physical and digital customer experiences and leading omnichannel business development.

Experience working closely with digital product, technology, data and AI-enabled business development.

jobs.occupation: Product Manager (Professional Hygiene) Kiilto in Malmö
jobs.description:
Are you ready to take ownership of one of the market’s most established and well-known brands in professional hygiene? As a Product Manager at Kiilto, you will be the driver behind DAX – steering the portfolio, developing the market and delivering commercial results. You will be part of an engaged Nordic team that takes pride in what they do and genuinely enjoys working together.
We are now looking for a Product Manager to join Kiilto in Malmö!
This is a permanent, full-time position with a preferred start as soon as possible.

What does Kiilto do?
Kiilto is a Finnish, family-owned chemical and chemical technology company founded in 1919 and now in its fourth generation of family leadership. With approximately 700 employees across nine countries, Kiilto develops, manufactures and sells products and solutions across four business areas: Construction, Industrial Adhesives & Fire Protection, Professional Hygiene, and Consumer Products.
As a company with over 100 years of history, Kiilto combines deep expertise with a clear focus on the future, investing in sustainability, innovation and customer impact as the cornerstones of long-term growth.
Learn more at www.kiilto.com
What does a Product Manager do at Kiilto?
As a Product Manager at Kiilto, you take ownership of assigned product lines within Professional Hygiene, ensuring they remain competitive, compliant and commercially successful. You are the voice of the customer and the driver of your portfolio. The role is based in Malmö and forms part of a broader Nordic product management team (Denmark, Finland and Sweden).
Your focus will be on the DAX portfolio and Kiilto Pro range, primarily serving healthcare customers such as hospitals, regions and professional cleaning environments. This is not a passive portfolio management role. We are looking for someone who proactively drives their products forward and takes clear ownership of the result.
Some of your key responsibilities:

Drive Product Lifecycle Management (PLCM) for your assigned product lines

Maintain product roadmaps and lifecycle plans – and drive actions to keep products competitive

Identify development, improvement and discontinuation opportunities in collaboration with cross-functional teams

Prepare business cases and strategic recommendations

Monitor product performance, profitability and competitiveness

Gather customer and market insights and translate them into product decisions

Ensure product information, labelling and regulatory compliance are up to date

Support Sales with product expertise, training, tender activities and complex customer cases

Who are you?
We are looking for a commercially driven product manager who takes ownership and is comfortable making decisions in a cross-functional environment. You don't need to come from a traditional product management background – a strong sales background combined with a commercial mindset works equally well.
What matters most is that you are proactive, structured and genuinely curious about your products and your customers. Product Lifecycle Management experience is a must, everything else we can develop together.
Requirements for this role:

Experience in product management or product lifecycle management 

Strong commercial and analytical mindset – ability to assess product performance and drive decisions

Experience of cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management

Fluent in Swedish and English – both written and spoken

Comfortable working independently as part of a distributed Nordic team

Experience from a regulated environment (professional hygiene, chemicals, pharma or similar), familiarity with CRM tools such as Salesforce, or a background close to sales teams is highly advantageous. An interest in sustainability is a plus.
What we offer! 
At Kiilto you get a broad and impactful role in a stable, family-owned company with a long-term perspective and a genuine sustainability agenda. You work in a friendly, ambitious team in Malmö, with regular collaboration across the Nordics and Finland.

A role with real ownership – you drive your products and see the impact

Part of a supportive, international Nordic team that works well together

A company in active transformation – room to grow and take on more responsibility

Apply today!
Submit your application in english today by uploading your CV, or apply with your LinkedIn URL. We replace the cover letter with screening questions to ensure a fair and efficient application process.
Selection is ongoing and the position may be filled before the application deadline.
In this recruitment, Kiilto is working together with ROI Rekrytering.
For questions, please contact recruitment consultant Lisa Alsterberg at lisa.alsterberg@roirekrytering.se

Company Description

Customs Operations Europe and Africa region in Älmhult, Sweden consists of approximately 47 co-workers. The department includes a dedicated team of Customs Compliance Specialists, alongside operational customs teams, working together to secure well-functioning import and export processes for more than 30 countries in the region. We provide daily support and coordination on customs-related topics, including legal requirements, goods flow, and IT solutions, to secure availability, affordability, and compliance.

Job Description

The Customs Compliance Specialist ensures the efficiency and compliance of the import and export activities in their region and for the countries assigned to their region.
You will:
· In conjunction with the Customs Compliance Manager, establish and maintain Compliance procedures and working methods associated with areas of responsibility
· Lead and coordinate customs classification activities within the assigned area of responsibility, ensuring accurate tariff classification, compliance, and alignment with business needs.
· Manage and support customs compliance programs including post-entry corrections, free trade agreements, bonded solutions and other customs special procedures.
· Lead or support customs compliance reviews, internal assessments and external customs audits.
· Support the establishment and maintenance of customs compliance controls, risk mitigation activities and corrective action plans.
· Build strategic relationships with internal and external business partners, including Customs or other Government agencies
· Work with Finance, Accounting, Transport and Purchasing partners on compliance issues
· Maintain regulatory knowledge and analysis skills as business, regulations or systems change to meet business needs
· Support business expansion and customs-related projects by securing customs compliance readiness and operational implementation.

Qualifications

We are now looking for a new colleague who wants to be a part of our amazing team. We believe you are motivated and inspired by the above assignments. You have plenty of energy and curiosity to learn, and we see that you are a person that is driven and dares to challenge people around you. You are service-minded, with a clear and respectful way of communicating. You enjoy working in a structured way both on your own, within the team and with relevant stakeholders. You have high integrity and the ability to establish relationships at all levels of
the organization, based on trust. You can work with both operational and tactical issues, and you possess facilitation and trainer skills. You can prioritize your work to deliver assignments with high quality. You also can analyze the details while keeping focus on the big picture and follow up on relevant goals and deviations.
You should be:
· Comfortable with working and navigating in digital IT solutions
· Fluent in English, both written and verbal
We believe that you have:
· Demonstrated knowledge of Customs Import/Export regulations and compliance management
· Strong knowledge and practical experience in customs valuation, rules of origin, Free Trade Agreements, customs special procedures, compliance controls, and customs audits and investigations, with the ability to identify risks, ensure compliance, and support business objectives.
· Solid knowledge and practical experience in customs classification (tariff classification) and related processes, including the application of customs regulations and maintenance of classification data.
· Experience and knowledge of Change Management
· Good listening skills and strong ability to document and communicate in a clear way
· Ability to build efficiency and compliance into operations while meeting the business needs
· Previous experience in working with external authorities

Additional Information

Please note this position is based in Älmhult, Sweden. For this position we expect that you will work the majority of your time from the office.

Turn complex customer priorities into long-term strategic partnerships. At Business Area Intelligent Manufacturing, you own and grow a portfolio of named enterprise accounts, build trusted executive-level relationships, and lead value-based solutions that bring together software, industrial metrology, and services across divisions. 
About the job 
You shape how we engage with strategic customers, moving from product- and division-level transactions to coordinated, multi-year partnerships. With clear accountability for each assigned account, you connect customer priorities with cross-divisional capabilities and create measurable business value. You report to the Strategic Account Director. 
Job responsibilities 
Develop strategic account plans covering customer priorities, growth opportunities, key stakeholders, opportunity roadmaps, and risks. 
Build trusted executive relationships, establish sponsorship, and lead regular executive business reviews. 
Identify and lead complex, multi-division opportunities from early engagement through negotiation and closing. 
Create business cases and value propositions focused on outcomes such as productivity, quality, cost, and time to market. 
Orchestrate virtual account teams across sales, presales, services and customer success, ensuring coordinated customer engagement. 
Manage pipelines, forecasts, and account progress while driving customer adoption, renewals, and expansion. 

Location  
The position is based in Stockholm, Sweden, and includes extensive domestic and international travel to customer and Sandvik sites. 
Your profile 
You’re an accomplished strategic account professional with extensive B2B sales experience and a strong record of developing enterprise customers. A solid understanding of manufacturing and digital manufacturing enables you to connect customer challenges with integrated, value-based solutions. 
Your background includes 
Extensive experience in strategic, key or global account management, including complex, multi-year solution sales. 
Proven ability to lead extended sales cycles, engage multiple stakeholders and negotiate enterprise agreements. 
Experience selling software, technology and services to discrete manufacturing industries. 
A university degree in engineering, business administration, or an equivalent field. 
Experience with structured selling methodologies and working in a matrix or multi-divisional organization. 
Fluent written and spoken English, along with proficiency in CRM platforms and Microsoft 365. 

International experience, further education in sales leadership or strategic account management, Swedish or another European language, and a category B driving license are advantages. 
You’re strategic and commercially minded, communicating credibly with executive stakeholders and turning complex information into clear, compelling narratives. You lead through influence rather than formal authority, bringing structure, integrity, and ownership to every engagement while creating alignment across teams with different priorities. 
The team 
You lead a virtual account team for each assigned customer, bringing together colleagues from sales, presales and solution architecture, services, and customer success. Close collaboration extends across divisional leadership, product management, finance, legal, marketing, sales operations, and partner management. 
Our culture 
At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. We invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences. Visit our stories hub, LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us further.
